GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 091.3 (18 Jan 46) ESS/FI
(SCAPIN-615)
APO 500
18 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Appointment of a Committee of Conservators for Institutions Closed pursuant to Memorandum of This Headquarters, AG 091.3 (30 Sep 45) ESS.
1. It is directed that the Imperial Japanese Government constitute a Committee of conservators for certain institutions closed pursuant to Memorandum AG 091.3 (30 Sep 45) ESS, this Headquarters, dated 30 Sep 45, subject “Closing of colonial and Foreign Banks and Special Wartime Institutions,” and appoint as members of the committee persons acceptable to this Headquarters.
2. The committee of conservators shall have all the powers and authority of the officers and directors of such institutions. However, in the exercise of such powers and authority the Conservators shall perform only those acts which this Headquarters shall from time to time direct.
3. The Imperial Japanese Government is further directed to make available to the committee and to its accredited representatives upon request all books, records, documents, reports and other material relating to the closed institutions and their subsidiaries and affiliates and in the possession of the Imperial Japanese Government, its agents and instrumentalities and other persons and organizations in Japan.
4. The Imperial Japanese Government is further directed to make available to the Committee such personnel as the committee may designate.
5. The Bank of Chosen, the Bank of Taiwan, Deutsches Bank für Ostasien, Banque Franco-Japonaise, Chosen Colonization Bank, Banque de I’Indo-Chine and National Financial Control Association are excepted from the provisions of this memorandum.
6. If the Imperial Japanese Government deems it necessary to promulgate an ordinance to carry out the provisions of this Memorandum, such ordinance will be submitted to this Headquarters for approval prior to promulgation.
7. The Imperial Japanese Government is directed to report on action taken to implement the provisions of this memorandum.
8. Direct communication between the interested Staff Sections of this Headquarters, the Committee of Conservators and Ministries Concerned is authorized to implement the provisions of this directive.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.Allen
Colonel,A.G.D.
Asst Adjutant General
